title: Clockwork Banquet
rules: Three trays are conserved. Carry one tray, or put it down on a cell without another loose tray.
Load a clean tray at the matching pantry. Vegetable and protein each have three ingredients.
Start the raw portion at its matching stove. The tray stays there during three cooking ticks.
Ready food spoils after twelve age ticks. Serving happens before that tick's ageing.
The hatch asks for vegetable, protein, vegetable, protein, in that order.
Serving leaves a dirty tray. Carry dirty or spoiled trays to the sink to wash them.
Loose trays on row y=3 move one cell on even ticks. Endpoints and occupied tray cells stop movement.
A cook at (4,5) reverses the whole belt, helping one delivery route while delaying another.

observation_labels.meaning: Self role one-hot in declared role order.
t: Nonterminal clock, frozen after joint terminal. Flattened row-major.
done: Joint terminal latch. Flattened row-major.
terminated: Natural cause latch. Flattened row-major.
truncated: Cap-only latch, excluding natural termination. Flattened row-major.
tiles: Actual y-major terrain codes; see tile legend. Flattened row-major.
agent_pos: Agent [x,y] coordinates in role order. Flattened row-major.
agent_active: All roles remain present through joint terminal. Flattened row-major.
carrying: Held object index; -1 means empty. Flattened row-major.
tray_pos: Physical [x,y] per tray; held trays follow their cook. Flattened row-major.
tray_active: Native tray active in declared entity index order. Flattened row-major.
holder: -1 loose on floor/belt/station, otherwise holder role 0..2. Flattened row-major.
food: 0 none, 1 vegetable, 2 protein. Flattened row-major.
stage: 0 clean, 1 raw, 2 cooking, 3 ready, 4 dirty, 5 spoiled. Flattened row-major.

station_pos: Ordered vegetable pantry, protein pantry, vegetable stove, protein stove, sink, control, hatch. Flattened row-major.
station_active: Native station active in declared entity index order. Flattened row-major.
station_kind: Station index/type 0..6 in that same order. Flattened row-major.
stock: Remaining vegetable and protein pantry ingredients. Flattened row-major.
direction: Conveyor x direction: +1 east, -1 west; moves on even resulting t. Flattened row-major.
course: Number of requested courses served; next type is 1 + (course mod 2), unless course=4 terminal. Flattened row-major.
served: Cumulative served portions, vegetable then protein. Flattened row-major.
waste: Cumulative discarded ingredients at washing, vegetable then protein. Flattened row-major.
tray_moved: Per-tray belt displacement in this step. Flattened row-major.
served_now: A correct requested portion was served this step. Flattened row-major.
loaded_now: Per-tray ingredient load this step. Flattened row-major.
washed_now: Per-tray washing this step. Flattened row-major.
reversed: Conveyor was reversed this step. Flattened row-major.
